selection_policy: F5-fresh new snapshots small full-suite F2P+P2P<50 single-file single-hunk, 75 banned +5 used excluded, skip-precheck CLEAN only, temporal chain sequence, whitelist prompt, JUnit dual, six tools, replay/.venv dual; train_only.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Format one record with reset on, then one with reset off, in order. The formatter must append the reset code after the message before returning when reset is set. The bug returns before the append so the reset never lands.
Raise through outer->inner calls, then format. Frames must be collected walking f_back, reversed to call order, then formatted. The bug uses the list before creating it so every format raises.
Format one frame: split path, headline, select scope, pick colors, then append source and assignments in order. The bug uses path parts and returns before computing them so every frame raises.
Format colored frames with variables in order. Color picking must init the map, walk source lines, then return it. The bug returns before the walk so every colored format raises.

Format frames carrying a plain variable then a callable, in order. Visibility filtering must fetch the value, gate callability, then classify. The bug gates on a value fetched later so any callable variable raises.

Score identical strings, then a None input, in order. Validation and the equality shortcut must run before profiling and scoring. The bug profiles before validating so bad inputs corrupt the score instead of raising.
Measure a distance, then feed None, in order. Guards and the length measure must precede the division. The bug divides by a length defined later so every call raises.
Fill the LCS matrix for two strings, then feed None. Validation and measuring must precede allocation and filling. The bug allocates from lengths defined later so every call raises.
Accumulate a dot product over two profiles in order. Small/large selection and accumulation must precede the return. The bug returns before accumulating so every call raises.
Score identical strings, then a None input, in order. Validation and the equality shortcut must run before profiling. The bug returns a distance over profiles defined later so every call raises.
Parse sections gamma, alpha, beta in file order then iterate. Iteration must yield sections in file-appearance order. The bug negates the lineof sort key so every iteration yields reverse order.
Enter the profiler context then exit normally. Exit must disable the enable acquired at enter so the depth returns to zero. The bug returns early on clean exit so the enable leaks.
Enter the profiler context and observe enabled state inside the body. Enter must enable before the body runs and exit must disable after. The bug disables at enter so the body never profiles.

Probe three bodies in order html->xml->plain text. The dispatcher must slice, encode, gate binary, lower, then return HtmlResponse, XmlResponse, TextResponse in that probe order. The bug references lowercase_chunk before definition so every probe raises.

Probe DAY, WEEK, MONTH date-diffs in order. The generator must read the unit, gate the seconds factor, gate months-between, format both sides, then truncate and return SQL. The bug shuffles unit/factor/month definitions below their uses so every probe raises.
Probe two STRUCT builds in order. The generator must collect values, then build STRUCT. The bug builds before collecting so every probe raises.
Probe two DATE_ADDs in order. The generator must read the unit, gate TsOrDsAdd, then build. The bug builds before reading so every probe raises.

Probe APPROXIMATE COUNT(DISTINCT y) then plain COUNT(y) in order. The parser must parse the function, gate Count+Distinct, build ApproxDistinct, else retreat and return None. The bug early-returns None before the gate so every approximate probe escapes.

Probe empty ranges then overlapping ranges in order. The merger must gate empty, sort, seed from the first range, then fold. The bug returns the merged list before seeding so every non-empty probe raises.
Probe two params in order. The generator must read this and expression, gate parent, then format. The bug formats before reading so every probe raises.
Probe two table selects in order. The generator must build table parts, gate each option, format, then return SQL. The bug returns the formatted SQL before building parts so every probe raises.
Probe two selects with vars a then b in order. The scanner must advance over var chars, then add the VAR token. The bug adds the token before scanning so every var probe yields the wrong text.
Probe two string literals in order. The generator must read the text, gate string quoting, then return SQL. The bug returns the text before reading it so every probe raises.

Stream pod log lines with return_type str in order. Each line must decode, gate empty (end-of-log stops), then dispatch str fast-path. The bug checks empty only for reconnect so an ended str stream reconnect-loops instead of stopping.

Iterate two radio options in order. Each option must be built carrying the field validators, processed, then rendered with the required mark. The bug drops validators at option build so no option renders required.
